entries.summary: [SUMMARY] I searched the September transactions and found two uncategorized rows: SQ *KILN & CO STUDIO (id 279, -$240.00) and AMZN MKTP US*2K4LQ1 (id 298, -$73.22). I proposed categorize_transaction for Kiln (id 279) as Shopping, an existing category, and the human approved it, so the outcome was "committed". I left the ambiguous Amazon charge for the user to decide, since the second card was optional and the order contents are unknown.
